# Docling GUI

> Docling GUI is a free, MIT-licensed desktop application (Windows / macOS / Linux) that
> batch-converts documents using IBM's open-source docling engine. It recursively converts
> all 37 format families / 88 extensions docling supports — PDF, Word (docx/doc), Excel,
> PowerPoint, images (OCR), audio/video (ASR), HTML, EPUB, email and more — into Markdown,
> HTML, lossless JSON (DoclingDocument), DocTags XML or plain text. Conversion is fully
> local and offline; no code is required. A CLI with the same capabilities is included.

Key facts:

- Repository: https://github.com/Ikaros-521/docling-gui
- License: MIT (free for personal and commercial use)
- Platforms: Windows 10+ x64, macOS 12+ Apple Silicon, Linux x64 (prebuilt packages); source runs on Python 3.10+
- Parsing engine: docling >= 2.149.0 (IBM); UI: PySide6 + QFluentWidgets
- Typical uses: batch PDF-to-Markdown for Obsidian/knowledge bases, RAG/LLM data preparation, scanned-document OCR, audio transcription
- Recursive batch with resume (existing outputs skipped), per-format selection, mirrored output directories, embedded-image export

## Related

- [docling](https://github.com/docling-project/docling): the upstream parsing engine this GUI wraps
- [QFluentWidgets](https://qfluentwidgets.com/): the UI component library
